title: LIISA JA TIIT TEEVAD SOOJA TEED

characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene, armas 5-aastane tüdruk kollases lühikeste varrukatega kleidis ja sinistes pükstes, pruunid patsid ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: TIIT
characters.description: Väike inimene, armas 5-aastane poiss rohelises kapuutsiga pusas ja hallides pükstes, lühikesed heledad juuksed ja rõõmus ilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Soe köök
locations.description: Cozy kitchen with light wooden walls, warm wooden floor, single large window on back wall showing rainy autumn weather outside with falling yellow leaves. A round wooden table in the center with two small wooden chairs. Light blue kitchen counter against left wall. Warm cozy lighting inside contrasting with the grey rainy day outside. Clean, colorful, and simple cartoon style.

pages.scene: Liisa and Tiit stand near the large window in a cozy kitchen, looking out at the heavy rain and falling yellow autumn leaves. Liisa wears a yellow short-sleeved dress over blue pants. Tiit wears a green hoodie and grey pants. Raindrops splash on the window glass outside. The room is brightly lit and warm inside. Liisa has light brown hair in two high pigtails with red hair ties and wears a plain yellow short-sleeved dress with a round collar over blue pants and orange shoes. Tiit has short messy blond hair and wears a plain green hoodie, grey pants and dark shoes. Same kitchen as the location reference: flat ceiling, no hanging lamp, light blue cabinets and stove on the left, one large window in the back wall.

Liisa and Tiit are standing together in the cozy wooden kitchen next to the wooden table. Liisa smiles brightly and points toward the tea cups sitting on the table. Tiit looks cheerful and claps his hands gently.
Liisa stands by the wooden table carefully holding a teapot, pouring warm steaming tea into two ceramic mugs placed on the wooden table. Tiit stands next to her watching with a happy smile.
Liisa uses a small spoon to drop golden honey from a honey jar into one of the steaming tea mugs on the wooden table. Warm steam rises gently from the cups. Tiit watches eagerly.
Tiit holds a small juicy red apple slice and carefully places it into his tea mug on the wooden table. Liisa sits on a small wooden chair smiling warmly at Tiit.
Liisa and Tiit lean in close over the two steaming mugs of tea on the wooden table, closing their eyes with happy expressions as they smell the fragrant tea. Wisps of steam curl gently from the cups.

Liisa and Tiit are both seated at the round wooden table, holding their white ceramic tea cups with both hands and taking careful, happy sips. The cozy kitchen background stays consistent with rainy window behind them. The tea is in the same white ceramic cups on white saucers as on the earlier pages, not glass mugs. Liisa has light brown hair in two high pigtails with red hair ties and wears a plain yellow short-sleeved dress with a round collar over blue pants and orange shoes. Tiit has short messy blond hair and wears a plain green hoodie, grey pants and dark shoes. Same kitchen as the location reference: flat ceiling, no hanging lamp, light blue cabinets and stove on the left, one large window in the back wall.

Liisa and Tiit sit at the table drinking tea, each holding a round tasty cookie in hand. A plate with a few remaining cookies sits between their white ceramic tea cups on saucers on the wooden table. The tea is in the same white ceramic cups on white saucers as on the earlier pages, not glass mugs. Liisa has light brown hair in two high pigtails with red hair ties and wears a plain yellow short-sleeved dress with a round collar over blue pants and orange shoes. Tiit has short messy blond hair and wears a plain green hoodie, grey pants and dark shoes. Same kitchen as the location reference: flat ceiling, no hanging lamp, light blue cabinets and stove on the left, one large window in the back wall.

Liisa and Tiit smile big and wave happily at the viewer, sitting warmly at the kitchen table with empty white ceramic tea cups on saucers and a plate with cookie crumbs. Outside the window, rain falls, but inside they are warm, comfy, and overjoyed. The tea is in the same white ceramic cups on white saucers as on the earlier pages, not glass mugs.
